result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: a restaurant image appears stuck in a loading state, and horizontally scrolling content is clipped awkwardly at the right edge.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar image has a large loading spinner over it even though the underlying artwork is already visible, making the card look stuck or only partially loaded.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading indicator as soon as the image is rendered, or keep the image hidden behind a consistent skeleton placeholder until loading completes.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and the third card in “Fastest near you” are cut off by the viewport, including truncated restaurant and delivery text. Although these may be horizontal carousels, the clipping looks abrupt and makes content appear broken.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent partial-card preview with adequate trailing padding, and ensure text stays within each card rather than being visibly sliced at the screen edge.
